# Missing ratings on real data (generated by scripts/run_missing_real.py)

Every FUSE variant uses the posterior as the final predictor (the logistic step needs complete features). 'missing = 0' is the paper's convention used in all earlier DICES runs; 'skip' is missing-aware FUSE (src/fuse/missing.py). Differences are paired bootstraps, 2000 resamples.

## RTE

800 items, 164 raters, 94% missing, median 10 ratings per item, positive rate 50%

| Method | Accuracy | vs MV (95% CI) | vs Dawid-Skene (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Majority vote | 90.1 |  |  |
| Dawid-Skene | 93.0 | +2.9 [+0.8, +4.9] |  |
| FUSE, missing = 0 (paper) | 69.1 | -21.0 [-24.4, -17.9] | -23.9 [-27.2, -20.4] |
| FUSE skip, triplet posterior | 90.1 | +0.0 [-2.2, +2.2] | -2.9 [-4.4, -1.4] |
| FUSE skip, product posterior | 92.0 | +1.9 [-0.2, +4.0] | -1.0 [-2.1, +0.0] |
| FUSE skip + EM | 93.0 | +2.9 [+0.8, +4.9] | +0.0 [+0.0, +0.0] |
